title: Atomic Chat embedding model catalog
description: Embedding models the app offers on the Local API Server. Every model runs on stock llama.cpp (`llamacpp-upstream`, `llama-server --embedding`), from one GGUF plus an optional multimodal projector. Each model is pinned to one commit; the app downloads every listed file into <data>/embedding/models/<id>/<path>, checking bytes and sha256, and hands it to the core, which starts the embedding server and serves it on /v1/embeddings. Every size is the exact byte count from the Hugging Face API.

path.description: Path inside the repository and inside the model folder.

role.description: `model` is the file passed with -m, `mmproj` the multimodal projector passed with --mmproj.

prompts.description: Text the model expects in front of each input, shown in the app for API clients to copy. The server never adds them; they apply to text only.

id.description: Stable id: the folder name under embedding/models and the model id the engine answers with (-a), which API clients pass as `model`.

revision.description: The full commit the files are pinned to; URLs are https://huggingface.co/<repo>/resolve/<revision>/<path>.

context.description: Tokens per input the engine is started with (-c, and -b/-ub: an encoder reads one whole input per batch). Media tokens count too.

max_context.description: The longest input the model was trained for; never below `context`.

matryoshka_dims.description: Shorter lengths the vectors can be truncated to (re-normalize after truncating), largest first, all below `dims`.

pooling.description: --pooling. The model's own pooling, also written in its GGUF.

modalities.description: What one input may hold. Anything beyond text needs an `mmproj` file and goes in a `content` array of the input.

image_max_tokens.description: --image-max-tokens: the token budget one image is resized to. Image models only.

default.description: The model the app suggests first. At most one.

min_engine.description: The oldest upstream llama.cpp release that runs this model, as its tag.

icon.description: Logo key the client maps to a bundled image (web-app/src/lib/model-logo.ts, ICON_KEY_LOGOS). Required: every embedding model shows its maker's logo.
